verdicts.title: 1-wei fee swap on an uninitialised pool permanently blocks the first mint (pool initialisation DoS)

a.reden: The candidate describes a pool initialization DoS due to division by zero, which is unrelated to the reentrancy issue in burn described in H-01.

b.reden: The candidate describes a DoS on pool initialization due to a 1-wei fee swap, which is a different root cause and impact than the known reentrancy in burn finding.

verdicts.title: mint prices U reserves at 0.9985 but burn pays them at face value: risk-free mint/burn extraction

a.reden: The candidate describes a pricing discrepancy between mint and burn, not the reentrancy issue in burn described in H-01.

b.reden: The candidate describes a mint/burn pricing mismatch, not the reentrancy via external token transfer before LP accounting in H-01.

verdicts.title: executeFeeSwap has no access control and lets anyone swap at a fixed 0.997 rate

a.reden: Different function and issue; candidate describes missing access control, known finding is reentrancy in burn

b.reden: The candidate describes an access control issue in executeFeeSwap, while the known finding is about reentrancy in burn.

verdicts.title: No uint128 overflow check on reserve additions in a pre-0.8 compiler (unchecked arithmetic)

a.reden: The candidate describes an unchecked uint128 overflow issue, which is unrelated to the reentrancy bug in H-01.

b.reden: The candidate describes an arithmetic overflow in executeFeeSwap/mint, while the known finding is about reentrancy in burn.

verdicts.title: burn transfers tokens before updating balances and reserves (reentrancy)

a.reden: Both describe the same reentrancy issue in FeeAMM.sol's burn() where token transfers occur before state updates

b.reden: The candidate describes the same burn() reentrancy caused by external token transfers before updating LP accounting in FeeAMM.sol.

verdicts.title: ERC20 transfer and transferFrom return values are ignored, with no SafeERC20

a.reden: The candidate describes unchecked ERC20 return values, while the known finding is about reentrancy in burn, a different root cause.

b.reden: The candidate describes unchecked ERC20 return values, while H-01 describes a reentrancy/CEI violation in burn(); these are different root causes.
